applicant.name: Dr. Martin Eder
applicant.organisation: Medical University of Innsbruck, Department of Respiratory Medicine

purpose: We study how often patients with COPD in different age groups receive inhaler treatment, for a regional care report.
question: Provide pseudonymised records of all patients with COPD and their inhaler prescriptions.
definitions: COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Inhaler = ATC code starting with R03.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per age band: patients with COPD and % with an active inhaler, one decimal.
